title: Closeout summary: FTS rebuild can stamp stale snapshot with fresh head
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Search rebuilds now hold the canonical state lock before snapshot/head capture, retry contention, and validate the rebuilt content-bound artifact.

Close reason: Rebuild snapshot and event head are coordinated under one lock and cannot be stamped across a concurrent write.
